Navigating an invitation like this requires balancing genuine support with professional boundaries. You might consider saying something like: "I am so incredibly proud of you and deeply honored that you would invite me to such an important milestone. Your hard work and dedication are what got you to this graduation, and it has been a privilege to support you along the way."

You can then gently explain the boundary by adding: "Due to professional ethics and my commitment to protecting your confidentiality, I am unable to attend the ceremony in person. However, I am absolutely thrilled for you and would love to dedicate time in our next session to celebrate this amazing achievement together." This approach validates their success and expresses your gratitude for the invitation, while safely upholding the ethical boundaries necessary in a therapeutic relationship.
